en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town in a hilly landscape. In the middle stands a large medieval castle complex with thick stone walls and at least two prominent round towers with conical roofs and small finials. Around the castle are trees, gardens, and clustered houses with steep gabled roofs. In the right background there is a tall factory chimney, suggesting early industrialization. Rolling fields and wooded hills form the distant backdrop. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
